persistence_recovery_micro_slice.purpose: Obtain two consecutive scheduler-survival boundaries with role-valid durable continuation while still advancing the Phase-1 parity root and avoiding the long semantic chains associated with repeated approximately-63-second stops.
required_order: Read INSTRUCTION_CONTROL_MANIFEST and RUN_LIFECYCLE, then obey the exact role-specific bootstrap ordering. In particular, preserve any role-authorized pre-DESIRED invocation-entry witness before DESIRED_STATE.

Read only the role control and the minimum current root/continuation authority required for the role-valid micro-slice. Do not consume O, downstream, other-worker semantics, or public web for CLEAN roles.

Select one deterministic local Phase-1 root-contributing action that can finish inside the micro budget, such as validating current continuation/claim identity, performing one local exact-scope reconstruction check, or advancing one already-materialized deterministic verification step. Do not start a source-discovery or multi-hop chain.

Persist one compact role-local semantic checkpoint or receipt with exact authority identities, what was actually verified, no unsupported completion claim, and a nonempty exact next continuation; exact-read it back once.
persistence_recovery_micro_slice.persistence_accounting: A readback-valid micro-slice may count as a scheduler-survival boundary only if the task remains enabled afterward and the receipt is role-valid under current semantic authority. It earns usefulness/scientific-output credit only if the independent usefulness gate qualifies the actual content; no automatic usefulness credit is granted.
persistence_recovery_micro_slice.exit_rule: The optimizer retires a role from this temporary mode only after observing two consecutive post-repair enabled boundaries with role-valid durable continuation. Until then, the role remains in this same temporary method rather than returning to an unbounded semantic chain.
persistence_recovery_micro_slice.failure_rule: If a role again disables and no micro-slice receipt exists after the scheduled start, re-enable the same current-pool task on the next optimizer reconciliation, reset persistence to 0/2, preserve exact evidence, and classify the stop as unresolved runtime/platform or pre-checkpoint behavior. Do not disable other workers, re-enable self_improvement, weaken CLEAN, or mutate primary/protected O authority.

exception_paths.missing_capability: Record the exact missing surface and alternative-route child in one compact durable checkpoint, then normal-return recurring-open.
exception_paths.rate_limit_or_transient_connector_error: Do not sleep or retry in the same invocation. Persist the exact error, idempotency/CAS state and continuation, then normal-return recurring-open.
exception_paths.CAS_or_authority_mismatch: At most one immediate reread under the common lifecycle only; persistence-recovery micro-slice mode performs no CAS reread. Persist diagnostic continuation and return rather than spin.
exception_paths.write_surface_failure: Prefer one compact role-local checkpoint/receipt over multiple outputs. If no safe write succeeds, emit noncompletion without claiming durable progress and retry next invocation.
exception_paths.already_completed_leaf: Record integration evidence if needed and select no second leaf; persist next-leaf continuation and return.
exception_paths.blocked_leaf: Persist blocker and next alternative child; do not wait or restore unrelated base work during Phase 1.
